test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Of the six cities, Aliganj is bigger than Sewa Nagar. Hari Nagar is bigger than Nand Nagri. Jaitpur is smaller than Hari Nagar but bigger than Sewa Nagar. Sewa Nagar is smaller than Nand Nagri but bigger than Rampur. Which is the smallest city?
solution:
**Given: **

1) Of the six cities, Aliganj is bigger than Sewa Nagar. 

Aliganj > Sewa Nagar

2) Sewa Nagar is smaller than Nand Nagri but bigger than Rampur.

Aliganj / Nand Nagri > Sewa nagar > Rampur

3) Hari Nagar is bigger than Nand Nagri. 

Case 1) Hari Nagar > Aliganj / Nand Nagri > Sewa nagar > Rampur

Case 2) Aliganj > Hari Nagar > Nand Nagri > Sewa nagar > Rampur

4) Jaitpur is smaller than Hari Nagar but bigger than Sewa Nagar. 

Case 1) Hari Nagar > Aliganj / Nand Nagri / Jaitpur > Sewa nagar > Rampur

Case 2) Aliganj > Hari Nagar > Nand Nagri / Jaitpur > Sewa nagar > Rampur

Thus, in both cases Rampur is the smallest city.

Hence, **"Option 3"** is the correct answer.
